title: Fix file picker export and getPath; add onError, bookmarks and web save dialog
body:
## Description

Fixes four file picker bugs found while building Save As in Annodoc. Also adds a few things picked up from comparing Calf with FileKit, which are cheap to add before 1.0.0. Two code review passes followed; their findings are fixed here too.

### Bug fixes

- **Android save wrote a 0-byte file.** The bytes or file to save were held in a plain `remember`, which was lost while the save sheet was open. They now live in `rememberSaveable`, so a file source also survives process death. The created document gets a real MIME type from its extension.
- **A failed Android save could destroy the file the user overwrote.** The save sheet returns either a new, empty document or an existing file. Now the source is opened before the destination is truncated, only an empty document is deleted after a failure, and a provider that refuses `"wt"` gets `"w"` for a new document only.
- **iOS export name had a `<UUID>-` prefix** (cherry-pick of `2145426`). Staged files now go into `tmp/<area>/<UUID>/<name>`, so the sheet offers the requested name.
- **iOS export moved the source file** (also from `2145426`). The export sheet now uses `asCopy = true` and says "Save", not "Move".
- **`KmpFile.getPath()` wasn't a filesystem path on mobile.** It now returns a decoded filesystem path or `null`:
  - Android returns a path only for `file:` URIs; content URIs give `null`.
  - iOS returns the path of the readable copy.
  - The new `KmpFile.toUriString()` gives the URI that `getPath()` used to return.
- **Android metadata of a picked folder crashed or came back empty.** A folder pick is a bare tree URI, which documents providers refuse to query. `getName`, `getSize`, `getMimeType` and `isDirectory` now ask about the tree's root document; `getSize` is `null` for folders.
- **iOS swipe-dismiss mid-animation was never reported.** A shared `DocumentPickerDelegate` handles both delegate protocols and reports the result exactly once.
- **iOS picked documents lost their names and were stored twice.** Picked files keep their original names, and the picker's own `asCopy` copy is moved into staging instead of copied again.
- **A failed pick or save could leave the caller waiting.** See the `onResult` rule below.
- **Android didn't report a missing documents app.** An `ActivityNotFoundException` now goes to `onError` instead of crashing.

### New API

- **`onError: (FilePickerException) -> Unit`** on `rememberFilePickerLauncher` and `rememberFileSaverLauncher`, on every platform.
  - **Every launch ends with exactly one `onResult` call**, so a loading state can always be cleared there. `onError` comes first when something failed; the picker then delivers the files that could be read (empty if none), and the saver delivers `null`.
  - The overloads without `onError` stay; failures reach them as an empty list or `null`.
- **`FilePickerSettings(initialDirectory: KmpFile?)`** opens dialogs in a folder the user picked. On iOS this uses `directoryURL`.
- **New `KmpFile` functions:**
  - `KmpFile.fromUriString(…)` rebuilds a file from `toUriString()` or from an absolute path.
  - `getSize()` and `getMimeType()`.
- **Bookmarks:** `createBookmark()`, `KmpFile.fromBookmark(…)` and `releaseBookmark()` keep access to picked files across restarts.
  - Android persists URI permissions.
  - iOS stores a bookmark and holds security-scoped access on the resolved URL until release (FileKit #667). Files reopened from the same location share one access, so reopening a bookmark repeatedly does not pile up access.
  - Desktop stores the absolute path; the web has no bookmarks.
- **Web save dialog:** the saver uses `showSaveFilePicker` where the browser has it (Chromium, including Chrome on Android 132+). Safari and Firefox, or a refused dialog, fall back to a download, which ends with `onResult` and the downloaded file. The download's blob URL is kept alive for 40 s so Safari can finish reading it.

### Behaviour changes and migration

All are documented in `docs/filepicker.md`.

- `getPath()` on Android and iOS no longer returns a URI string. Use `toUriString()` where you relied on the URI.
- The picker overload without `onError` now gets `onResult(emptyList())` after a failure, where it used to get nothing.
- On the web, a download now calls `onResult` with the downloaded file, where it used to call nothing.
- `FilePickerSettings(initialDirectory = null)` no longer compiles, because the call matches both the `String?` and the `KmpFile?` overload. Leave the argument out instead.
- Libraries *compiled* against 0.14.x that call the launchers must be rebuilt. Source code compiles unchanged.

## Related Issue

None on GitHub. These were reported from Annodoc's Save As work.

## Type of Change

- [x] Bug fix
- [x] New feature
- [x] Improvement
- [x] Documentation update
- [x] Build/CI change (Robolectric + Compose UI test deps for Android host tests)

## Platforms Tested

- [x] Android: host tests (Robolectric), plus manual passes on a Pixel 9 emulator (API 35)
- [x] iOS: simulator unit tests, plus a UI pass on an iPhone 17 Pro simulator (iOS 26.2), driven with XCUITest
- [x] Desktop: unit tests
- [x] Web: the Wasm sample in a Chromium browser, with `showSaveFilePicker` stubbed (see below)

### Tests

Passing locally: calf-io Android 17, desktop 17, iOS 24; calf-file-picker Android 22, desktop 16, iOS 20.

- **Android:** a fake documents provider that answers like the system's (a real `DocumentsProvider` can't be queried under Robolectric) covers folder metadata, deleting only empty documents, keeping overwritten files, and the `"w"` fallback. Launcher tests check that every pick and save ends with one `onResult`, after `onError` on failure.
- **iOS:** path, metadata, bookmark and staging tests, plus the shared bookmark access counted with injected start/stop (the simulator has no real security-scoped URLs).
- **Desktop:** initial directory, failure messages, and the order of `onError` and `onResult`.

### Android emulator pass

- [x] Export writes a valid 374×374 PNG (32,417 bytes), stored as `image/png`.
- [x] Cancelling the save sheet reports a cancel.
- [x] A picked file shows `null` from `getPath()` and a content URI from `toUriString()`, plus the right size and MIME type, and can be read as a stream.
- [x] "Pick Directory" on Documents shows the folder's name, "Unknown size", type `vnd.android.document/directory`, and the app keeps running.
- [x] A folder bookmark holds a persisted read+write grant, which is still there after the app's process is killed.

### iOS simulator pass

- [x] The save sheet offers `profile_picture` (extension hidden by the sheet) and says "Save", not "Move". The file lands as `profile_picture.png`, a valid 318×318 PNG, and the saver's staging folder is emptied.
- [x] Swiping the save sheet down reports "Save cancelled", both after it settles and while it is still sliding in. Swipes 40–200 ms after the sheet starts appearing, in 20 ms steps, were all reported; none dismissed silently.
- [x] With a picked folder as the initial directory, the picker opens in that folder. That holds even after a pick from another folder, which moves the system's remembered location. After Reset, it follows the remembered location again.
- [x] A file picked there shows its original name, a readable-copy path (`tmp/calf-file-picker/<UUID>/notes.txt`), `25 bytes · text/plain`, and streams.

The iOS 26 save sheet has no Cancel button; swiping down is how it is dismissed. This pass ran before picked documents were moved instead of copied; the move is covered by unit tests.

### Web pass (Wasm sample, Chromium, save picker stubbed)

- [x] Save: Calf calls `showSaveFilePicker` with `suggestedName: profile_picture.png` and an `image/png` / `.png` type, writes the PNG (1,073 bytes) and the sample shows "Saved successfully".
- [x] Cancel (`AbortError`) shows "Save cancelled".
- [x] A refused dialog (`SecurityError`, e.g. no user gesture) downloads `profile_picture.png`, and `onResult` gets the downloaded file ("Saved successfully").
- [x] Without `showSaveFilePicker` (Safari, Firefox) the file is downloaded and `onResult` gets it too. Both downloads' blob URLs are still readable 2 s after the click.
- [x] No console errors.

### Still to check

- [ ] Chrome's own save dialog by hand (the stub covers Calf's side only).
- [ ] Safari: Export Photo downloads the file.

## Checklist

- [x] Builds successfully on all targeted platforms
- [ ] Verified UI behavior across at least one mobile and one desktop target (Android and iOS done; desktop UI not checked by hand)
- [x] Updated documentation/examples if the API or usage changed
- [ ] Confirmed no breaking changes without proper deprecation notice (there are some, intended for 1.0.0; see Behaviour changes and migration)
